findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-app.fundz.net" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_lead_detail, search_funding_rounds, get_watchlist_changes, get_company_contacts, who_do_i_know, search_hiring_intel, search_raised_and_hiring, search_office_expansions, search_layoffs · Private data: get_lead_detail, search_executive_changes, get_saved_filters, get_investor_profile, search_sec_filings, search_filing_text, get_company_contacts, who_do_i_know, reveal_contacts, get_contact_reveal_quota, search_layoffs, search_office_permits · Public sink: get_watchlist_changes, toggle_email_notifications, get_company_contacts, who_do_i_know, reveal_contacts · Destructive: get_lead_detail, search_funding_rounds, search_executive_changes, get_saved_filters, remove_from_watchlist, search_hiring_intel, search_raised_and_hiring.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_lead_detail, search_funding_rounds, get_watchlist_changes, get_company_contacts, who_do_i_know, search_hiring_intel, search_raised_and_hiring, search_office_expansions, search_layoffs · Private data: get_lead_detail, search_executive_changes, get_saved_filters, get_investor_profile, search_sec_filings, search_filing_text, get_company_contacts, who_do_i_know, reveal_contacts, get_contact_reveal_quota, search_layoffs, search_office_permits · Public sink: get_watchlist_changes, toggle_email_notifications, get_company_contacts, who_do_i_know, reveal_contacts · Destructive: get_lead_detail, search_funding_rounds, search_executive_changes, get_saved_filters, remove_from_watchlist, search_hiring_intel, search_raised_and_hiring

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
